### ST-049

**Vitest adapter**

*As a **Vitest user**, I want **SmartTest to discover and run my Vitest tests through Vitest itself**, so that **I keep my runner, config and plugins**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 8 | S4 | J01, §15.1 | [ST-009](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-009), [ST-022](DET-project-detection.md#st-022) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Discovers test files and test cases using the project's Vitest config
- [x] Runs a file selection (and test-case selection where supported) and returns normalized results
- [x] Declares capabilities honestly; results match a native `vitest run` on fixtures

### ST-050

**Jest adapter**

### ST-051

**Normalized test model and honest result statuses**

*As a **developer**, I want **one test model and status vocabulary across runners**, so that **reports never misrepresent what happened**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S4 | J03, J04, §15.5 | [ST-049](EXE-test-execution.md#st-049), [ST-050](EXE-test-execution.md#st-050) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Statuses: passed, failed, skipped, pending, cancelled, timed-out, flaky, infrastructure-error (cached-* reserved)
- [x] 'Skipped by selection' is distinct from 'skipped by the test' and is never counted as passed
- [x] Runner crashes map to infrastructure-error, exit code 4

---

### ST-052

**Test-to-source mapping (TESTS edges)**

*As a **SmartTest engine**, I want **test files linked to the source symbols they import and exercise statically**, so that **selection can walk from code to tests**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S5 | K02, §10.3 | [ST-044](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-044), [ST-038](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-038), [ST-049](EXE-test-execution.md#st-049), [ST-050](EXE-test-execution.md#st-050) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] TESTS edges created from test-file imports to symbols, including through mocks (`vi.mock`/`jest.mock` recorded as uncertainty)
- [x] Test files with no resolvable target are flagged
- [x] Mapping matches `expected.json` relationships on fixtures

### ST-053

**Scheduling, timeouts and cancellation**

*As a **developer**, I want **selected tests run in parallel with timeouts and clean cancellation**, so that **runs are fast and Ctrl-C never leaves orphans**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S5 | J05, J06, J07, §15.3 | [ST-051](EXE-test-execution.md#st-051) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Worker count derives from CPU/memory unless configured
- [x] Global and per-run timeouts produce `timed-out` statuses
- [x] SIGINT cancels child processes and reports `cancelled` within 2 s

---

### ST-054

**Retry policies and flaky marking**

*As a **QA engineer**, I want **configurable retries where a pass-after-fail stays visibly flaky**, so that **instability is surfaced, not hidden**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟧 Should | 3 | S8 | J08, J11, §15.6 | [ST-053](EXE-test-execution.md#st-053) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `retries` configurable globally and by rule
- [x] A test that fails then passes is reported as `flaky`, never as plain `passed`
- [x] Flaky occurrences are recorded in `.smarttest/runs/`

---

*As a **developer**, I want **timings for every phase recorded locally**, so that **I can see SmartTest's overhead versus its savings**.*

|---|---|---|---|---|
